title: Foundation AD: list users/groups, describe membership, grant/revoke group membership
description: Runs `nexus acl foundation-ad {list,describe,grant,revoke}`. list = 7 users + 5 groups; describe shows a user's MemberOf; grant/revoke round-trips a service account in/out of an AD group via Add-/Remove-ADGroupMember. Administrator/krbtgt/nexusadmin are protected.

observe.what: 7 users + 5 groups (nexus-vault-readers/operators/admins, nexus-gmsa-consumers, nexus-sql-cluster-members); protected: Administrator, krbtgt, nexusadmin
nexusadmin described with its MemberOf group list

steps.command: nexus acl foundation-ad grant --user svc-vault-smoke --permissions nexus-vault-readers --yes

observe.what: svc-vault-smoke added to nexus-vault-readers via Add-ADGroupMember

steps.command: nexus acl foundation-ad revoke --user svc-vault-smoke --permissions nexus-vault-readers --yes

observe.what: svc-vault-smoke removed from nexus-vault-readers via Remove-ADGroupMember (round-trip clean); protected principals refuse changes

whatProves: FoundationAdAdapter.AclAsync lists the 7 users + 5 groups, describes a user's MemberOf, and round-trips a service account in and out of an AD group via Add-/Remove-ADGroupMember while protecting Administrator/krbtgt/nexusadmin.
